question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (4)
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The statement requires an option that correctly fits the context of a sequence or comparison.
 
• The word should indicate something that follows or is compared to another item or entity.
 
• "**Other**" fits well as it denotes something different or additional, aligning with the context of the statement.
 
• Other options ("**Every**", "**None**", "**Another**") do not fit the context as precisely.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Every (प्रत्येक): **"Every" means all members of a group, which does not fit the context of selecting one specific option.
 
• **None (कोई नहीं):** "None" means not any, which does not fit the requirement of selecting an option.
 
• **Another (एक और):** "Another" means one more, which does not align with indicating a different or additional entity as precisely as "Other".
